decisions.reason: As an adjacent API product that was still actively presented in 2024, it fits the firm's platform strategy of secure, integrated enterprise communications and likely reuses existing cloud and interface capabilities efficiently.

This gateway extends the firm's established multichannel communication portfolio in a way that supports automation and integration for enterprise workflows, so a large incumbent provider would usually continue it beyond launch.

This product complements the firm's email and messaging capabilities, matches its direction toward broader cloud-based business communications, and there is no sign by 2024 that it was being withdrawn.
